meta.title: {product}: the CRM and sales desk for travel agencies
meta.description: Leads from Google Sheets, Meta lead ads, WhatsApp, your website and spreadsheets in one list, given to the right person, with every follow-up on time.

hero.title: Every enquiry in one place, answered in minutes
hero.intro: {product} brings your leads from Google Sheets, Meta lead ads, WhatsApp, your website and spreadsheets into one list, gives each one to the right person, and keeps your team on top of every follow-up.
hero.graphic: A preview: leads from Google Sheets, lead ads, WhatsApp, your website and spreadsheets arrive in one list, each with its stage and owner.

sources.title: Leads from everywhere your customers are
sources.intro: Leads that arrive by themselves are worked like the ones your team adds by hand. Customers are matched by phone number, so one person stays one record however many times they ask.

sheets.name: Google Sheets
sheets.detail: Share your sheet once. New rows become leads within minutes, its columns matched to the right fields.

files.name: CSV and Excel files
files.detail: Upload a file, check the preview, and add thousands of leads at once, duplicates set aside.

byHand.name: Added by hand
byHand.detail: Calls and walk-ins in a few taps, with known customers recognised as you type.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.detail: Messages to your number become leads, and your team replies from the CRM.

metaAds.name: Facebook and Instagram lead ads
metaAds.detail: Meta's lead forms arrive the moment someone fills one in.

website.name: Your website
website.detail: A form for your own site, and a link you can share anywhere.

tools.name: Zapier, Pabbly and Make
tools.detail: A secure link that other tools post leads to.

features.title: Everything a travel sales team needs

items.today: Today's list for each person: overdue follow-ups, new leads waiting, what is due
items.pipeline: Leads move through the same stages for everyone: New, Contacted, Quote sent, Booking requested, Won
items.timeline: Each lead's whole story on one page: calls, notes, stage changes and repeat enquiries
items.bulk: Change many leads at once: assign, move stage, add a follow-up or export
items.assignment: New leads assigned by turns, by destination or by source, skipping anyone away
items.roles: Roles that decide what each person sees and does, own leads or everyone's
items.dashboard: Dashboards of leads, bookings and sales, by source and by person
items.ratings: Staff ratings from calls, replies, follow-ups on time and bookings won
items.branding: Your logo and colours on every quotation and document
items.audit: A log of every change: who did what, and when
items.exports: Your data in Excel whenever you want it
items.phone: Works on any phone, installs like an app, and copes with a weak connection

ai.title: An AI that answers your WhatsApp, day and night
ai.intro: Customers message at midnight and on Sundays. The AI replies in seconds, the way your best salesperson would, from what your agency has taught it.

read.title: Reads every message
read.detail: Text, voice notes and photos, with the whole conversation and the lead's details in mind.

reply.title: Replies like your best agent
reply.detail: In English, Hindi or Hinglish, in your agency's tone, from your own packages, prices and policies.

send.title: Sends what the customer needs
send.detail: Itinerary PDFs, photos, videos and payment details from your media library.

update.title: Keeps the lead up to date
update.detail: Destination, dates, travellers and budget are filled in as the chat goes, and a follow-up is set.

handOver.title: Hands over when it should
handOver.detail: A complaint, a refund or a question it can't answer goes to the right person at once, with the chat so far.

ai.control: You stay in charge: switch it on for the whole agency or for one chat, take over any conversation, and see every message it sent.
ai.graphic: A preview of a WhatsApp chat the AI handles

guides.title: Up and running in an afternoon

steps.one: Open Settings, then Lead sources, and choose to connect a sheet.
steps.two: Share your sheet with the address shown there, as a Viewer.
steps.three: Paste the sheet's link, check how its columns are matched, and choose whether to bring in the rows already there.

file.title: Bring in leads from a spreadsheet

steps.two: Upload your CSV or Excel file and match its columns.
steps.three: Check the preview, decide about duplicates, and add the leads.

steps.one: Open Staff and add each person, or import a list.
steps.two: Give each a role: Sales sees their own leads, Admins see everything.
steps.three: They sign in with their email, or with your organization code if they have none.

data.question: Is our data safe, and is it kept apart from other agencies?
data.answer: Every agency's data is kept apart in the database itself, so no screen or report can ever show another agency's records. Your files are stored privately and opened through links that expire in minutes.

whatsapp.question: Can we keep using the WhatsApp Business app on our phone?
whatsapp.answer: Yes. WhatsApp in the CRM is coming soon; when it arrives, your number stays on your phone, and chats you answer there show in the CRM too, so the conversation is complete in both places.

ai.question: What if the AI says something wrong?
ai.answer: The AI, coming soon, answers only from the packages, prices and policies you give it, hands the chat to a person when it isn't sure, and you can switch it off for any chat or for the whole agency. Every message it sends is marked and kept.

phone.question: Does it work on a phone?
phone.answer: Yes. It is built for phones first, installs like an app, and shows what was last loaded when the connection drops.

setup.question: How long does it take to start?
setup.answer: Most agencies connect their sheet, bring in their leads and add their team in an afternoon. Our tech team helps you through it.

team.question: Can salespeople see each other's leads?
team.answer: Only if you want them to. Each role sees its own leads or everyone's, and managers see the whole team.

leave.question: Can we take our data with us?
leave.answer: Yes. You can export your leads and staff to Excel at any time.

who.heading: Who we are
who.body: {product} is software that travel agencies use to manage their enquiries, customers and staff. Each agency decides what it records about its customers; we keep and process that data for the agency, on its behalf.

what.heading: What we keep
what.body: For an agency: its staff's names, sign-in emails and phone numbers, and what its staff record about their customers, such as names, phone numbers, trip details and messages. For a visitor to this page: nothing beyond what a web server notes for every request.

why.heading: Why we keep it
why.body: Only to run the service for the agency: to show its records to its own staff, to send the notifications and messages it asks for, and to keep the service secure. We never sell data and never use one agency's data for another.

where.heading: Where it is kept, and for how long
where.body: On servers in Asia, kept apart per agency. An agency's data is kept while it uses the service; when it leaves, its data is deleted permanently after the notice period in its agreement.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: If an agency holds your details, ask that agency to see, correct or delete them; we help it do so. Anyone may write to us about their data at the address below.

service.heading: The service
service.body: {product} gives your agency a place to manage enquiries, customers and staff, on the plan you choose. Features marked as coming soon are not part of a plan until they are available.

accounts.heading: Your accounts
accounts.body: Your agency's owner decides who may sign in and what each person may do, and is responsible for keeping sign-ins to the people who should have them.

data.heading: Your data
data.body: Your agency's data stays yours. You may export it at any time. You are responsible for having your customers' permission to record and contact them.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.body: Plans are paid monthly or yearly, as priced, with GST added. An unpaid subscription becomes read-only, and later suspended, after the notice the service shows.

use.heading: Fair use
use.body: Don't use the service to send messages people didn't agree to receive, or for anything unlawful. Messages sent through WhatsApp follow Meta's own policies too.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Write to {email} with any question about these terms.
